name: humor
quote: I liked the joke about the witch!
description: Delight driven by unusual social tension or connection that is perceived as clever and harmless to the self and other important people.
opposites: failed humor can go in many directions

variations.name: slapstick humor
variations.description: Slapstick humor is physical, e.g. someone tripping but not hurt.

variations.name: verbal humor
variations.description: Verbal humor can be jokes, puns, stories, insults, witty observations, etc.

variations.name: teasing
variations.description: Teasing is a gently irritating social interaction that can be verbal or physical.

variations.name: repetitive humor
variations.description: Surprise can be a factor in finding something funny, but old favorite jokes can still amuse.

variations.name: silly humor
variations.description: Attempts at humor that seem obvious, over-the-top, or cringingly manufactured.

variations.name: gross humor
variations.description: Attempts at humor that involve bodily fluids or noises that make young kids giggle.

commentaries.quote: Laughter doesn't always mean something is funny. It can also be a social signal that there's some kind of tension that the laugher hopes will resolve harmlessly.
Failed humor can be experienced in many ways, including: weird, gross, concern, cringe, embarrassment, disagreement, disappointment, humiliation, anger, and anxiety.

conditions: Unusual tension or connection, often social, that is perceived as clever and/or harmless.
